scientific_integrity: Theorems are for a real polynomial pencil; only endpoints λ=0,1 are necessarily lattice-polytope Ehrhart numerators. Proof rests on reciprocal-quartic reduction and exact Sturm rational certificates; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only ranks 3 and 4; no general higher-rank threshold or geometric realization for interpolation parameters outside endpoints. Endpoints are discriminant-zero and excluded from simple-root assertion.
title: Sharp real-rootedness intervals for the first two wheel–whirl pencils
